text:

0.1 16.01.2025
First lab session
This session oversaw a brief introduction to the lab and its background, where the aim was to understand the main theory and ideas behind the Ising Model.
To initialise the project, Git was used to efficiently share files for the project, and Quarto was used to write the lab report.

(Git repository for Ising Model Code can be found here: https://github.com/jamesnrolfe/IsingModel)

title: Introduction
text:
In the first session, time was taken to understand the Ising Model and its implications, and understand some theory behind its use.
To initialise the project, Git was used to efficiently share files for the project, and Quarto was used to write the lab report (Git repository for Ising Model Code can be found here: https://github.com/jamesnrolfe/IsingModel).
